title: Implement documented VWAP bounce reference BUY with completed-candle crossing tests
description:
Implement the required vwap_bounce reference BUY in mike_trade/strategies/buy/vwap_bounce.py as a BuyStrategy subclass using the j.1 SDK.

The definition is exact:
- Use completed 1-minute regular-session bars only.
- Use the warmed, fresh, session-reset shared VWAP that the MarketContext/indicator service supplies. The strategy must never compute VWAP from fetched data and never fetch data.
- A BUY signal triggers if and only if prior completed close <= prior completed-bar VWAP AND latest completed close > latest completed-bar VWAP.

No entry signal, with an explicit reason code, is produced for any of these inputs:
- incomplete or in-progress bar
- stale bar or stale VWAP
- missing bars or missing VWAP
- invalid values
- zero-volume bars
- VWAP that is not warmed
- fewer than two completed session bars
- a bar from a prior session, because VWAP resets each session
- outside regular session
- the managed symbol is not in WATCHING_BUY state

The same completed bar can never generate a duplicate signal. The signal ID is deterministic from (strategy_id, version, symbol, completed-bar UTC timestamp), and the strategy rearms naturally on the next valid upward crossing.

The spec must declare:
- id vwap_bounce, semver, BUY side
- 1m timeframe
- closed-bar-only and volume requirements
- warmup of 2 completed session bars plus VWAP warm
- trigger kind EDGE_ON_CLOSED_BAR
- methodology/source metadata describing the session-VWAP upward crossing, with an explicit statement that it is not a profitability claim
- execution limitations
- reason codes

It is registered independently and must not import or reference vwap_breakdown or any SELL module. Pairing happens later via configuration/presets. Do not add any extra filters beyond the definition. There is no broker, network, or filesystem access, and no confidence scores.

Write tests/unit/test_buy_vwap.py covering these crossing boundaries:
- prior close == prior VWAP and latest close > VWAP: signal
- latest close == latest VWAP: no signal
- prior close > prior VWAP: no signal
- downward cross: no signal

The tests must also cover:
- same-bar replay suppression
- rearm on a later fresh crossing producing a new ID
- stale data
- incomplete bar
- missing VWAP
- zero volume
- not-warmed VWAP
- session reset (a prior-session bar is not used as the prior bar)
- the not-WATCHING_BUY state
- registration without any SELL partner

Use Decimal throughout.

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/strategies/base.py
- mike_trade/strategies/registry.py
- tests/contracts/test_strategy_registry.py
- mike_trade/market_data/context.py
- mike_trade/market_data/candles.py
- mike_trade/strategies/indicators/core.py
- mike_trade/domain/signals.py
- mike_trade/domain/strategy_types.py
- mike_trade/risk/session_policy.py
- mike_trade/signals/rearm.py
acceptance_criteria: VwapBounceBuy subclasses BuyStrategy with spec id vwap_bounce, semver, BUY side, 1m completed-bar and volume requirements, warmup, edge trigger, methodology metadata stating no profitability claim, limitations, and reason codes.
A signal is emitted if and only if prior completed close <= prior VWAP AND latest completed close > latest VWAP, using only context-supplied session VWAP.

Boundary tests show prior close == prior VWAP with latest close > VWAP signals; latest close == latest VWAP does not signal; prior close > prior VWAP does not signal; a downward cross does not signal.
Incomplete, stale, missing, invalid, zero-volume, not-warmed, prior-session, out-of-session, or not-WATCHING_BUY inputs produce no entry signal with an explicit reason code.
Replaying the same completed bar never emits a duplicate signal; a later fresh crossing emits a new deterministic signal ID.
The module does not import or reference vwap_breakdown or any SELL strategy, and registers in StrategyRegistry with no SELL partner present.
The module has no broker, network, filesystem, or secrets imports and no confidence scores; prices use Decimal.
tests/unit/test_buy_vwap.py covers crossing boundaries, same-bar replay suppression, rearm, stale/incomplete data, and session reset, and passes when run in isolation.
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
add filters beyond the exact completed-bar session VWAP crossing definition
add a hard dependency on vwap_breakdown or any SELL module
fetch data, compute VWAP from external sources, or submit orders from the strategy
add confidence scores or profitability claims
create live broker orders or run broad test suites/backtests
